scaleAndRemoval.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit this CLEAN FULL GLOWHAVEN MASTER with TWO LOCAL CHANGES ONLY. Landscape 4:3, same framing, no zoom, no global redesign.

1. SHRINK the Evertree AND its circular palace precinct. They became much too large relative to this enormous metropolis. Scale the WHOLE tree-plus-palace group to approximately 68–70 percent of its current width AND height, uniformly in scene, anchored at the existing palace entrance/foot of the tree near full-image x590,y315. The top of the tree will therefore sit lower in frame with visibly more distant terrain behind/above it. Its palace should occupy only around 200–220 image pixels width instead of the current roughly 330. Tree canopy should be around 330px wide instead of nearly 470. Tree trunk becomes appreciably thinner. Do NOT compensate by enlarging towers, tree channels, courtyard or gardens. This is a vast city with thousands of tiny houses: even the governing palace is a modest compact complex at this master scale. Retain the current coherent circular ground-plan/elliptical projection, gold interwoven trunk with blue magical channels, gold-green canopy, root-concealing close palace wings, and gate alignment with its straight approach. Fill the space freed AROUND the smaller palace with fine residential streets, small well-kept houses and restrained planted paths that match existing Cloud District scale. Restore space freed above canopy with matching distant landscape; do not create new landmarks. Keep the upper approach STRAIGHT from unchanged central fountain to the same anchored palace entrance. Keep both removed palace-front pools ABSENT: ordinary planting/paving only, no fountains. Preserve central city fountain and academy courtyard pools.

2. REMOVE THE ENTIRE UNWANTED TEAL-AND-OCHRE HALL AND ITS TRAINING YARD in the EAST-CENTRAL city, approx x954–1083,y538–611 in the 1448x1086 image. This is the structure the user crossed out: north/northwest of the golden academy and east of the blue-grey civic hall beside the main diagonal road. Remove this whole honey-timber/stone teal-roof building AND the adjoining rectangular tan practice courtyard/targets/enclosing wall. Replace their whole footprint with ORDINARY SMALL HOMES and narrow residential lanes continuous with their neighbors. No new guildhall, arena, courtyard landmark or differently colored replacement. The other SMALL GREEN-ROOF TEAHOUSE farther SOUTH around x944,y693 stays untouched. The real Eternal Crucible northeast of central plaza remains untouched. This is an ART correction only, not deletion of any world-data records.

All other pixels/areas should remain as close as possible to source: huge city footprint, tiny houses, natural district palettes, four academy campuses, all other landmarks, main straight diagonal avenue and south gate, city walls, harbor, western mountains, southern slums/village/farms, coast and islands. Keep the skull-shaped rock on distant northeastern Wraith Island. No expansion of any feature, no saturation boost, no change of light or rendering style. Fine 2D illustrated rooftops and matte stone, no clay or blur. No labels, cross marks, construction guides, UI or watermark. One full 4:3 map.
